Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting user files in targeted folders and local drives
Deleting Shadow Volume Copies using vssadmin
Providing live support chat to guide victims through payment
Downloading and installing an uninstaller to remove ransom notes and infection files
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with user folders: Downloads, Documents, Pictures, User profile folders
Attack Vector: Spam email containing a link to a zip archive with a disguised executable (.scr)
Executable downloads ransomware and uninstaller from Command & Control servers
Indicators of Compromise: Files: %AppData%\PadCrypt\unistl.exe, package.pdcr, uninstl.pdcr, PadCrypt.exe, Files.txt, data.txt
Registry entries: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run "Microsoft Corp" and "PadCrypt" pointing to %AppData%\PadCrypt\PadCrypt.exe
Executable PDB path referencing Cryptowall: C:\Users\user\Documents\Visual Studio 2013\Projects\Cryptowall 2.0\Cryptowall\bin\Debug\Obfuscated\PadCrypt.pdb
